historic_survey.note: A Home Savings & Loan Association branch bank by Millard Sheets and his collaborative design studio, with a sculptural fountain and a mosaic mural, in the 'Home Savings Style' of New Formalism - monumental geometric massing, white travertine, integrated artworks and gold gilding. Most former Home Savings branches are now Chase Bank.

building.completed_conflict: The city's Modern & Postmodern styles context statement dates this building 1977; the assessor's roll records it as built 1975.

historical_record.description: Carries one of only two known Home Savings and Loan mosaic murals in San Francisco, installed 1975 in the long collaboration between the bank and the mosaic artist Millard Sheets.
